key_insight: PerceptRL makes fine-grained visual perception rewardable by converting caption errors into verifiable questions and supervising spatial accuracy during tool-assisted inspection.
engineering_relevance: The approach offers a post-training recipe for improving multimodal systems whose downstream reasoning depends on accurate visual details and tool operations.
method: Use a multi-agent pipeline to verify caption errors and convert visual facts into fixed-label chain or multiple-choice QA.
Apply Coordinate Injection to correct spatial operations in cold-start trajectories and grounding-aware rewards to supervise intermediate tool use.
Train through shared cold-start SFT, single-turn Perception RL, and multi-turn Perception Agentic RL.
evidence_signal: Across seven benchmarks under a shared tool-use protocol, PerceptRL reaches 71.6% average accuracy, exceeding the same-tool base model by 15.7 percentage points and the strongest evaluated frontier VLM by 5.2 points.
watch_item: Implementation depends on reliable error verification and spatial supervision; the abstract does not quantify their annotation or computational costs.
paper_title: PerceptRL: Making Visual Perception Rewardable in MLLMs from Answers to Interactions
